Name: SP_EFFECT_PARAM_ST
Description: Determines the parameters for special effects.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: The Icon ID shown while this effect stays active.

Fields.Name: Trigger at HP Below %
Fields.Description: Activates while remaining HP is below this cutoff. -1 removes the HP condition.

Fields.Name: Duration
Fields.Description: How long the effect lasts. -1 means permanent. 0 applies it once.

Fields.Name: Trigger Interval
Fields.Description: Time between repeated applications. 0 applies the effect every frame.

Fields.Name: Maximum HP %
Fields.Description: Multiplies maximum HP. 1 is unchanged. Current HP follows the new maximum unless Ignore Current HP on Max HP Change is set.

Fields.Name: Maximum MP %
Fields.Description: Probably does nothing. The game has no magic point pool to multiply.

Fields.Name: Maximum Stamina %
Fields.Description: Multiplies maximum stamina. 1 is unchanged. 0.5 halves it.

Fields.Name: Absorption %: Slash
Fields.Description: Multiplies slash damage the owner takes. Below 1 means less damage. Above 1 means more damage.

Fields.Name: Absorption %: Strike
Fields.Description: Multiplies strike damage the owner takes. Below 1 means less damage. Above 1 means more damage.

Fields.Name: Absorption %: Thrust
Fields.Description: Multiplies thrust damage the owner takes. Below 1 means less damage. Above 1 means more damage.

Fields.Name: Absorption %: Physical
Fields.Description: Multiplies physical damage the owner takes. Below 1 means less damage. Above 1 means more damage.

Fields.Name: Absorption %: Magic
Fields.Description: Multiplies magic damage the owner takes. Below 1 means less damage. Above 1 means more damage.

Fields.Name: Absorption %: Fire
Fields.Description: Multiplies fire damage the owner takes. Below 1 means less damage. Above 1 means more damage.

Fields.Name: Absorption %: Lightning
Fields.Description: Multiplies lightning damage the owner takes. Below 1 means less damage. Above 1 means more damage.

Fields.Name: Post-Defense Attack %: Physical
Fields.Description: Multiplies physical damage dealt. It applies after enemy defense instead of changing the attack rating. 1 is unchanged.

Fields.Name: Post-Defense Attack %: Magic
Fields.Description: Multiplies magic damage dealt. It applies after enemy defense instead of changing the attack rating. 1 is unchanged.

Fields.Name: Post-Defense Attack %: Fire
Fields.Description: Multiplies fire damage dealt. It applies after enemy defense instead of changing the attack rating. 1 is unchanged.

Fields.Name: Post-Defense Attack %: Lightning
Fields.Description: Multiplies lightning damage dealt. It applies after enemy defense instead of changing the attack rating. 1 is unchanged.

Fields.Name: Attack %: Physical
Fields.Description: Multiplies physical damage dealt. 1 is unchanged.

Fields.Name: Attack %: Magic
Fields.Description: Multiplies magic damage dealt. 1 is unchanged.

Fields.Name: Attack %: Fire
Fields.Description: Multiplies fire damage dealt. 1 is unchanged.

Fields.Name: Attack %: Lightning
Fields.Description: Multiplies lightning damage dealt. 1 is unchanged.

Fields.Name: Damage: Physical
Fields.Description: Adds physical damage to attack rating.

Fields.Name: Damage: Magic
Fields.Description: Adds magic damage to attack rating.

Fields.Name: Damage: Fire
Fields.Description: Adds fire damage to attack rating.

Fields.Name: Damage: Lightning
Fields.Description: Adds lightning damage to attack rating.

Fields.Name: Defense %: Physical
Fields.Description: Multiplies physical defense. 1 is unchanged.

Fields.Name: Defense %: Magic
Fields.Description: Multiplies magic defense. 1 is unchanged.

Fields.Name: Defense %: Fire
Fields.Description: Multiplies fire defense. 1 is unchanged.

Fields.Name: Defense %: Lightning
Fields.Description: Multiplies lightning defense. 1 is unchanged.

Fields.Name: Defense: Physical
Fields.Description: Adds to physical defense.

Fields.Name: Defense: Magic
Fields.Description: Adds to magic defense.

Fields.Name: Defense: Fire
Fields.Description: Adds to fire defense.

Fields.Name: Defense: Lightning
Fields.Description: Adds to lightning defense.

Fields.Name: Damage on Hit %: Unguarded
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may multiply damage against enemies that are not blocking. Leave it at 1 until tests prove more.

Fields.Name: Damage on Hit %: Weak Point
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may multiply damage on weak-point hits. Leave it alone until tests prove more.

Fields.Name: Damage on Hit %: Standard
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may multiply damage on normal hits. Leave it alone until tests prove more.

Fields.Name: Maximum HP Source Multiplier
Fields.Description: Unused. Maximum HP % does this job instead, so this multiplier never applies.

Fields.Name: Behavior ID
Fields.Description: The Behavior ID granted to the owner. It needs the Action ID designation behaviour for enemy attacks. Karmic Justice uses 171, but its limits are unproven.

Fields.Name: Damage HP (%)
Fields.Description: Removes this share of maximum HP each application. Negative values heal. 100 removes all HP.

Fields.Name: Damage HP by Point
Fields.Description: Removes this much HP each application. Negative values heal.

Fields.Name: Damage MP by Percentage
Fields.Description: Probably does nothing. The game has no magic point pool.

Fields.Name: Damage MP by Point
Fields.Description: Removes this much MP each application. Negative values restore MP. Vanilla has no usable MP pool.

Fields.Name: MP Recovery Speed
Fields.Description: Probably does nothing. The game has no magic point pool.

Fields.Name: Damage Stamina by Percentage
Fields.Description: Does nothing. Use Stamina Recovery Speed instead.

Fields.Name: Damage Stamina by Point
Fields.Description: Does nothing. Use Stamina Recovery Speed instead.

Fields.Name: Stamina Recovery Speed
Fields.Description: Adds to stamina recovery while this effect is active. Negative values slow recovery. This is a modifier, not the final recovery rate or a percentage.

Fields.Name: Magic Effect Duration Change
Fields.Description: Does nothing. Longer spell durations come from the Lifespan extension behaviour instead.

Fields.Name: Damage Durability by Point
Fields.Description: Damages equipped weapons and armour. Negative values repair them.

Fields.Name: Hits per Durability Loss
Fields.Description: Adds this many hits before equipment loses durability.

Fields.Name: Attack %: Stamina
Fields.Description: Multiplies stamina damage dealt. 1 is unchanged.

Fields.Name: Inflict: Poison
Fields.Description: Adds poison buildup to the owner's attacks.

Fields.Name: Inflict: Toxic
Fields.Description: Adds toxic buildup to the owner's attacks.

Fields.Name: Inflict: Bleed
Fields.Description: Adds bleed buildup to the owner's attacks.

Fields.Name: Inflict: Curse
Fields.Description: Adds curse buildup to the owner's attacks.

Fields.Name: Fall Damage %
Fields.Description: Does nothing. Falls use the Cat landing behaviour instead.

Fields.Name: Soul Absorption %
Fields.Description: Multiplies souls received from enemies. 1 is unchanged.

Fields.Name: Equipment Weight %
Fields.Description: Multiplies maximum Equip Load. 2 doubles it. 1 is unchanged.

Fields.Name: Item Weight %
Fields.Description: Does nothing. It is a leftover multiplier from Demon's Souls.

Fields.Name: Souls
Fields.Description: Adds or removes a flat amount.

Fields.Name: Animation ID Offset
Fields.Description: Shifts animation numbers. It can give an enemy a new moveset.

Fields.Name: Soul Possession %
Fields.Description: Multiplies souls the owner drops on death. It may only work from an enemy's own record. 1 is unchanged.

Fields.Name: Target Priority Addition
Fields.Description: Positive values encourage enemies to target the owner. Negative values encourage another target.

Fields.Name: Visual Search Reduction %
Fields.Description: Shrinks how far enemies see the owner. 50 halves that distance.

Fields.Name: Auditory Search Reduction %
Fields.Description: Shrinks how far enemies hear the owner. 50 halves that distance.

Fields.Name: Animation Playback Speed
Fields.Description: Multiplies animation speed. 1 is unchanged. 0.5 halves it.

Fields.Name: Resistance %: Poison
Fields.Description: Multiplies poison resistance from stats. 2 doubles it. 1 is unchanged.

Fields.Name: Resistance %: Toxic
Fields.Description: Multiplies toxic resistance from stats. 2 doubles it. 1 is unchanged.

Fields.Name: Resistance %: Bleed
Fields.Description: Multiplies bleed resistance from stats. 2 doubles it. 1 is unchanged.

Fields.Name: Resistance %: Curse
Fields.Description: Multiplies curse resistance from stats. 2 doubles it. 1 is unchanged.

Fields.Name: Soul Steal %
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may guard HP against Soul Steal. No test has proven it.

Fields.Name: Effect Duration Change %
Fields.Description: Multiplies the duration of another status. Effect Duration Change Type picks which one. 1 is unchanged.

Fields.Name: HP Recovery %
Fields.Description: Multiplies healing received. 1 is unchanged.

Fields.Name: Expire SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: Adds the selected effect when this effect ends.

Fields.Name: Cycle SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: Adds the selected effect at each trigger interval.

Fields.Name: Attack SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: Adds the selected effect to a victim on a hit. It needs a weapon-buff behaviour such as Enhanced Flame or Stun enhancement.

Fields.Name: Guard Defense Repulsion %
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may multiply weapon bounce off blocks. No test has proven it.

Fields.Name: Guard Stability %
Fields.Description: Multiplies shield stability. Requires stateInfo 158 (magic shield) or stateInfo 204 (great magic shield) to work (VFX present). Note that stability values over 100 nullify all stamina damage. 1 is unchanged.

Fields.Name: Raycast Passed Time
Fields.Description: Unknown. It belongs to the unused Evil Eye. No test has proven it.

Fields.Name: Poise
Fields.Description: Adds or removes Poise. It needs the Enhanced SA behaviour to work.

Fields.Name: Ammunition Distance %
Fields.Description: Changes the reach of bows and ranged weapons. 0 keeps it normal. Exact values need testing.

Fields.Name: SpEffect Category
Fields.Description: Groups effects for stacking rules. Each group decides whether a new effect joins, replaces, or restarts the old one. Overwrite restarts the old effect, including its timer.

Fields.Name: Category Priority
Fields.Description: Resolves priority within compatible stacking categories. Lower values have higher priority.

Fields.Name: Save Category
Fields.Description: Keeps the effect through quit and reload. Only one effect per group survives. This needs testing.

Fields.Name: Attunement Slots (Miracle)
Fields.Description: Probably does nothing. Attunement Slots (Magic) adds slots instead.

Fields.Name: Damage: Humanity
Fields.Description: Adds or removes humanity. -1 adds 1 and 1 removes 1.

Fields.Name: Repulsion Defense
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may change weapon bounce off the owner's weapon. No test has proven it.

Fields.Name: Repulsion Damage Absorption %
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may absorb damage from weapon bounce. No test has proven it.

Fields.Name: Bleed Damage Incurred %
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may multiply bleed damage. No test has proven it.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: No Impact
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may set the stun reaction for no-impact hits. No test has proven it.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Small Impact
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may set the stun reaction for small hits. No test has proven it.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Medium Impact
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may set the stun reaction for medium hits. No test has proven it.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Large Impact
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may set the stun reaction for large hits. No test has proven it.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Medium Blow
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may set the stun reaction for medium blows. No test has proven it.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Push
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may set the stun reaction for pushes. No test has proven it.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Strike
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may set the stun reaction for strikes. No test has proven it.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Small Blow
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may set the stun reaction for small blows. No test has proven it.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Minimal
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may set the stun reaction for minimal hits. No test has proven it.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Uppercut
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may set the stun reaction for uppercuts. No test has proven it.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Blow Backwards
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may set the stun reaction for blowback hits. No test has proven it.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Breath
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may set the stun reaction for breath hits. No test has proven it.

Fields.Name: Attack Attribute
Fields.Description: Sets the physical damage type of the owner's attacks.

Fields.Name: Special Attribute
Fields.Description: Sets the special damage type of the owner's attacks. It changes hit effects and death animations.

Fields.Name: State Info
Fields.Description: Selects the built-in system that grants unique effects. Many fields need the right value here to work. It also picks particle effects when Trigger Particles via SpEffect is on.

Fields.Name: Weapon Influence Type
Fields.Description: Limits the damage fields to one hand or all attacks. Ignore and Kick need testing.

Fields.Name: Movement Type
Fields.Description: Swaps the movement animation set. Chameleon and Iron Flesh use this.

Fields.Name: Effect Duration Change Type
Fields.Description: Picks the status whose duration Effect Duration Change % scales. 2 means poison and 5 means toxic.

Fields.Name: Throw Condition
Fields.Description: Changes grab rules like backstabs and ripostes. None keeps them normal. Most values need testing.

Fields.Name: Behavior ID: Condition
Fields.Description: May block certain attacks. No test links values to attacks.

Fields.Name: Behavior ID: Add
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may shift attack behavior numbers. Tests have failed so far.

Fields.Name: Apply to Host
Fields.Description: Lets the effect touch human characters. Hollows are excluded.

Fields.Name: Apply to Phantom
Fields.Description: Lets the effect touch hollow characters.

Fields.Name: Apply to Friendly Phantom
Fields.Description: Lets the effect touch white phantoms.

Fields.Name: Apply to Hostile Phantom
Fields.Description: Lets the effect touch red phantoms.

Fields.Name: Apply to Attacker
Fields.Description: Sends the effect back to the attacker. The victim must catch it from a bullet, attack, or weapon. Healing and damage fields then hit the attacker instead.

Fields.Name: Display Icon when Inactive
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may show the icon before the effect starts. It is never used.

Fields.Name: Trigger Particles via SpEffect
Fields.Description: Shows the State Info particle effect while active.

Fields.Name: Apply Intelligence Correction
Fields.Description: Lets a catalyst's magic adjustment scale some fields. Exact conditions need testing.

Fields.Name: Apply Faith Correction
Fields.Description: Lets a talisman's magic adjustment scale some fields. Exact conditions need testing.

Fields.Name: Apply Modifiers only after Game Clear
Fields.Description: Limits the effect to NG+ and beyond.

Fields.Name: Apply Modifiers to Sorcery
Fields.Description: Extends damage fields to sorceries and pyromancies.

Fields.Name: Apply Modifiers to Miracles
Fields.Description: Extends damage fields to miracles.

Fields.Name: Request: Friendly Phantom
Fields.Description: Used only by the White Sign Soapstone. It probably drives matchmaking.

Fields.Name: Request: Hostile Phantom
Fields.Description: Used only by the Red Sign Soapstone. It probably drives matchmaking.

Fields.Name: Request: Invader
Fields.Description: Used only by the Cracked Red Eye Orb. It probably drives matchmaking.

Fields.Name: Request: Kick Phantom
Fields.Description: Possibly removes all guests from the world.

Fields.Name: Request: Leave
Fields.Description: Used only by the Black Separation Crystal. It probably leaves the session.

Fields.Name: Request: Character Invader
Fields.Description: Used only by the Black Eye Orb. It starts a scripted invasion.

Fields.Name: Is Owner Undying
Fields.Description: Stops the owner from dying. It may only work in Remastered.

Fields.Name: Ignore Current HP on Max HP Change
Fields.Description: Keeps current HP fixed when Maximum HP % changes it. Off means current HP scales along.

Fields.Name: Disable Durability
Fields.Description: May protect the owner's gear from durability damage. This needs testing.

Fields.Name: Ignore Visual Search Adjustments
Fields.Description: May let the owner ignore Visual Search Reduction %. This needs testing.

Fields.Name: Ignore Auditory Search Adjustments
Fields.Description: May let the owner ignore Auditory Search Reduction %. This needs testing.

Fields.Name: Ignore Magic Block
Fields.Description: May let the owner ignore Vow of Silence. This needs testing.

Fields.Name: Ignore Decoy Target
Fields.Description: May let the owner ignore Aural Decoy. This needs testing.

Fields.Name: Ignore Decoy Target (Undead)
Fields.Description: May let the owner ignore Alluring Skulls. This needs testing.

Fields.Name: Ignore Decoy Target (Animal)
Fields.Description: Unknown. It is never used.

Fields.Name: Ignore Animation Playback Speed Changes
Fields.Description: Makes the owner ignore Animation Playback Speed.

Fields.Name: Is Vulnerable to Charm
Fields.Description: May let Undead Rapport charm the owner. This needs testing.

Fields.Name: Enable Duration via TimeAct Event
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may end the effect when the owner dies. This needs testing.

Fields.Name: Enable Target Activation
Fields.Description: Unknown. It belongs to the unused Evil Eye.

Fields.Name: Cancel Effect on Fire Damage
Fields.Description: Unknown. It is never used. It grants no fire immunity.

Fields.Name: Is Affected by Spell Duration Extension
Fields.Description: Lets the Lingering Dragoncrest Ring stretch this effect. The ring uses the Lifespan extension behaviour.

Fields.Name: Request: Leave Undead Match
Fields.Description: Used only by the Purple Coward's Crystal. It leaves the match.

Fields.Name: Trigger: None
Fields.Description: The effect only works with no covenant.

Fields.Name: Trigger: Way of White
Fields.Description: The effect only works in this covenant.

Fields.Description: The effect only works in this covenant.

Fields.Description: The effect only works in this covenant.

Fields.Description: The effect only works in this covenant.

Fields.Description: The effect only works in this covenant.

Fields.Description: The effect only works in this covenant.

Fields.Name: Trigger: Forest Hunter
Fields.Description: The effect only works in this covenant.

Fields.Name: Trigger: Blade of the Dark Moon
Fields.Description: The effect only works in this covenant.

Fields.Name: Trigger: Chaos Servant
Fields.Description: The effect only works in this covenant.
